message.content:
A high-angle photograph shows a landscape of destruction along a coastline. The ground is covered in debris, mud, and flattened areas, with a single white mosque standing in the center. The mosque has several domes, including a large central dark grey dome and two smaller ones. Its structure features arched openings, and it appears relatively intact compared to the surrounding devastation. To its left, a few green and blue tents are pitched near some trucks. Scattered palm trees and a few brown, leafless trees remain standing. In the background, a body of water meets a beach, with forested hills rising in the distance. A narrow road cuts through the debris.

Large white text at the top reads "EDISI KHUSUS 10 TAHUN TSUNAMI" above the word "TEMPO". Below "TEMPO" is smaller text: "22-28 DESEMBER 2014". At the bottom, white text reads "MENGENANG ACEH..." alongside a barcode and price "RP 35.000". Other small, illegible text is printed near the barcode.
